quests.title: A big pile goes
quests.ask: Write `take_big_pile()`: on a cell holding the smallest pile that counts as big, it leaves the cell empty.
quests.nudge: Read the brief again: which pile sizes count as big?

quests.title: A small pile stays
quests.ask: Called on a cell with the biggest small pile, `take_big_pile()` should leave every gem exactly where it is.
quests.nudge: What question does the robot ask before it takes anything?

quests.title: Every cell, the first too
quests.ask: Now a short corridor that starts on a big pile. Only the small pile should be left at the end.
quests.nudge: Does the robot ever look at the cell it starts on?
